name: Perpetua
description: Perpetua is the fee rights exchange for Meteora. It transforms the trading fee stream of a permanently locked DAMM v2 position into a priced, tradable, claimable asset via an Anchor program, DLMM liquidity markets, and an integrated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI assistants.

paragraphs: The fee-rights exchange for Meteora. I built Perpetua to turn the trading-fee stream of a permanently locked DAMM v2 position into a priced, tradable, claimable asset.

Every DBC launch that graduates into DAMM v2 leaves behind liquidity that can never be withdrawn and earns fees forever. Today that income is stuck in one wallet, and nobody can price it, sell it or buy into it. Perpetua fixes that end to end:
It works for any asset that trades on DAMM v2, so it does not depend on the current meme-stock meta.
features: Price it. A decay-aware valuation model reads live on-chain fee history and returns fair value, a bear/base/bull range and risk flags.
Securitize it. An Anchor program takes custody of the locked position's NFT account (never the funds) and mints 1,000,000 fee shares. It has no instruction that can touch the principal.
Sell it. The shares list on a DLMM pair as a one-sided ask ladder seeded around fair value.
Earn from it. Holders stake shares and harvest real token A/B fees. Claim-on-touch accounting closes the JIT-staking window.
Automate it. A hosted MCP server with 20 tools lets any AI assistant price, simulate and build every transaction in the flow without ever holding a key.

whatItDoes.text: The fee-rights exchange for Meteora. I built Perpetua to turn the trading-fee stream of a permanently locked DAMM v2 position into a priced, tradable, claimable asset.

requirements.text: An assistant needs only the address: no key, no install, no account.
Extra signatures a flow needs (a share mint, a DLMM position account, a DBC config) are generated in the browser and partial-signed there.
